candidates.title: File:2012-07-27 Windpark Hohenahr von Wetzlar aus.jpg
candidates.description: Die sieben Windradtürme des Windparks Hohenahr von Süden aus gesehen. Im Vordergrund sind die Buderuswerke (links) und der Dom von Wetzlar zu sehen. Die Türme sind in diesem Stadium bereits 91 m hoch und bestehen aus Betonelementen, die mit Kränen aufeinandergesetzt werden. Ganz rechts werden gerade die letzten Elemente aufgesetzt.

candidates.title: File:2012-08-19 Windpark Hohenahr von Wetzlar aus.jpg
candidates.description: The Windfarm Hohenahr as seen from the nearby town of Wetzlar. The seven wind wheels are still under construction. Already installed are towers of fabricated concrete parts with a height of 91 meters. Atop of the concrete towers will be set steel towers with an additional height of 46 meters. In the foreground you can see Wetzlar with the Buderus Company to the left and the dome to the right.

candidates.title: File:2012-12-27 Windpark Hohenahr von Wetzlar aus.jpg
candidates.description: The Windfarm Hohenahr with three wind wheels already running. For further description see the file from 2012-08-19.

candidates.title: File:2013-02-02 Windpark Hohenahr von Wetzlar aus.jpg
candidates.description: Windpark Hohenahr fertiggestellt, Blick von Wetzlar aus (Süden)

candidates.title: File:2013-10-19 Windpark Hohenahr von Wetzlar aus.jpg
candidates.description: The Hohenahr Windfarm as seen from the south (from the town of Wetzlar). To the left you can see the towers of the Buderus Company and to the right the Wetzlar Cathedral (Dom) surrounded by the ancient town. At the foot of the Windfarm you can see the Autobahn 45 (A45) called the Sauerlandlinie.
